newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka undecided on 25,000 tonne rice tender.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka undecided on 25,000 tonne rice tender.

text.p: Sri Lanka was undecided on Wednesday on awarding a tender for the import of 25,000 tonnes of white raw rice, an official for the state buying arm Cooperative Wholesale Establishment (CWE) said.
The CWE has received 20 offers for the tender, which closed last Friday, said the official who asked not to be named.
"The awarding has not yet been decided," she said.
CWE officals earlier said the 25,000 tonnes were for delivery in two lots during late December and early January next year.
In October, Sri Lanka bought 12,500 tonnes of white raw rice from Pakistan and a similar quantity of parboiled rice from India.
The government has said it plans to import up to 400,000 tonnes of rice by the end of this year to meet a crop shortfall caused by drought and rising demand.
They said the shortfall caused by drought this year was about 300,000 tonnes in addition to the country's average annual rice shortage of around 200,000 tonnes.
